summary: Runtime dependency sourced from unpinned third-party GitHub repository
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` runtime dependency as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or semver pin. On `npm install`, npm resolves that reference to whatever HEAD of the referenced repository currently points to, fetches it from outside the npm registry, and runs its lifecycle scripts and native build steps in the installer's environment. The referenced GitHub account is a third-party user unrelated to any established publisher, there is no integrity check, and the resolved content can change at any time without any new version of raiden-baileys being published. Whoever controls that external repository controls code executed on every machine that installs this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
